checks: New games start in English with three independent rod templates and no granted equipment
Individual setups save, replace and delete as component snapshots without inventory changes
Saving and applying enforce ownership, matching components and gear level gates
Thirty-template limit allows replacement while rejecting additional templates
Level-300 six-slot loadout supports two feeders, three carp rods and one float concurrently
Positions may have gaps while duplicate, locked, noninteger and malformed slots are rejected
Applying to a chosen slot checks combined physical quantities and per-style limits atomically
Editing a template or whole loadout leaves the running session equipment snapshot intact
Save, reload and old-version migration retain balances, normalize legacy positions and persist language
Prestige keeps knowledge and chosen language; imports strip unknown fields and reject invalid or duplicate entries
